approval_basis: TASK-20260801-012 returned verdict REVISE with recommendation_to_task_013 DO_NOT_APPROVE, and its attainability_check.md reports unreachable branches. Either condition alone compels NOT APPROVED under the frozen constraints; both hold. RC-22 permits no second amendment cycle, so BATCH-022 records NON-EXECUTION for RUN-SMTH-001-heur.

blocking_defects.M-4_demonstration_invalid: M-4 is formally reachable but its attainability demonstration is invalid on both legs (the diagonal quadratic-residue claim is false; the CDF-displacement argument measures the CDF of N, not the LPF statistic DV-4 tests). After A-1 is repaired M-4 becomes the MODAL branch under the truth of the hypothesis - a false weaken.
blocking_defects.RV012-A1: FATAL. TAIL-DS-1 fails on a CORRECT null, so M-5 leg (a) fires deterministically and M-1, M-2, M-4 and M-6 are jointly unreachable. p_ext = min_j rho(u_j) makes n*p_ext ~ Exp(1), so P(pass) = 1/e = 0.368 - the contract stated this INVERTED as about 1 - 1/e. The reviewer then EXECUTED the declared null arm end to end (8 draws x 131328 uniform integers per cell, frozen ladders) and measured TAIL-DS-1 passing 0/8 at bits 16 and 0/8 at bits 20, largest p_ext*n anywhere 0.73, because asymptotic rho under-predicts deep-tail smoothness at X around 2^32 to 2^40. Even on the idealised figure, under the TRUTH of the hypothesis P(M-5) = 0.865 and P(M-2) = 0.018. This is BATCH-021's D-2 defect through a probabilistic guard instead of a hard cap.
blocking_defects.RV012-A2: FATAL. ENC-B and ENC-A are undefined on exactly 512 of the 131328 half-tuples. The leading coefficient of S_3(x1,x2,Z) in Z is (x1-x2)^2, zero iff x1 = x2, so the 512 diagonal draws divide by zero. Dropping them - the only mathematically available choice - leaves C(512,2) = 130816 and M-0 fires on EVERY possible outcome; sentinel-filling is an undeclared post-freeze choice that also breaks matched n for DV-4. M-0's degenerate clause is written at >1 percent so it stays silent at 0.39 percent.

process_finding: THE ATTAINABILITY DUTY WORKED, AND ON ITS FIRST USE. It was introduced one batch ago because BATCH-021 shipped a map that was exhaustive, honestly applied, and had an arithmetically unreachable favourable branch. Here it caught two fatal unreachability defects BEFORE any compute was spent on the real arm, and it did so because the reviewer executed the null arm rather than reasoning about it. The cost of catching this was about two minutes of CPU.
